visual_review.method: view_image on all 12 final figure types; six timeline figures rechecked after final Chinese legend change; unchanged data figures retained identical rendering.
checks: Chinese labels legible, no cropped text or overlapping legends
Each strategy timeline stops at its own first-card completion; 2s U does not pad drain with zero
ASU full trajectory retains repeated waits; Once shorter endpoint explicit
All CDF tails visible, x normalized by each request own 8-layer compute, 1.5 threshold matches counts
HOL example is same-request internal layer, HBM-ready endpoint and conservative FIFO backlog explicitly distinguished
Warm and zoom AB coverage labels reflect actual counts
Exact nominal-demand plot uses decimal GB/s and distinguishes V/C from physical throughput

definitions.U: Exact compute overlap divided by NPU count and wall time
definitions.SLO: Admission cohort followed to final completion; elapsed<=1.5*own_compute+1e-9ms
definitions.primary_window: [2,4) seconds; additional long windows never clipped
definitions.tail: A window after first NPU finish is explicitly flagged, never called sustained all-card work
definitions.nominal_demand: Current admitted request per-disk V/C, decimal GB/s; extra next-request L0 excluded
definitions.source_history: Current source mismatch is recorded separately from source_unchanged during the archived run
definitions.scope: Only native runs/*/*; phase_search and interp_search excluded; no final scientific conclusion inferred

removed_draft_figures.reason: Earlier ASU-only draft superseded by final paired 2-60s demand figure; raw statistics retain 2-90s ASU.
